skills.name: LangChain
skills.description: Framework for developing applications powered by language models. Provides chains, agents, memory, and integrations with 100+ tools.

skills.name: LangGraph

skills.name: AutoGen
skills.description: Microsoft's framework for enabling next-gen LLM applications via multi-agent conversation. Supports autonomous and human-in-the-loop workflows.

skills.name: CrewAI
skills.description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents. Enables collaborative agents to accomplish complex tasks.

skills.name: Semantic Kernel
skills.description: Microsoft's SDK for integrating AI services like LLMs into conventional programming languages. Supports planners and skills.

skills.name: LlamaIndex
skills.description: Data framework for building LLM applications over external data. Provides indexing, retrieval, and query engines for RAG.

skills.name: ChromaDB
skills.description: Open-source embedding database for AI applications. Provides vector storage, similarity search, and metadata filtering.

skills.name: Qdrant
skills.description: Vector similarity search engine with extended filtering support. Written in Rust, provides high-performance vector search.

skills.name: Weaviate
skills.description: Cloud-native vector database with GraphQL and REST APIs. Supports hybrid search, modules for embeddings, and multi-tenancy.

skills.name: Haystack
skills.description: End-to-end framework for building NLP applications. Supports RAG, question answering, semantic search, and document processing.

skills.name: DSPy
skills.description: Framework for algorithmically optimizing LM prompts and weights. Replaces prompt engineering with systematic optimization.

skills.name: Guidance
skills.description: Programming language for controlling LLMs. Enables constrained generation, structured output, and interleaved logic.

skills.name: Instructor
skills.description: Library for structured outputs from LLMs. Uses Pydantic models for validation, retries, and streaming support.

skills.name: OpenAI Python SDK
skills.description: Official Python client for OpenAI API. Supports chat completions, embeddings, images, audio, and fine-tuning.

skills.name: Anthropic Python SDK
skills.description: Official Python client for Anthropic API. Supports messages, streaming, and tool use with Claude models.

skills.name: Ollama Python Client
skills.description: Python client for Ollama local LLM inference. Supports chat, generate, embeddings, and model management.

skills.name: LiteLLM

skills.name: Hugging Face Transformers
skills.description: State-of-the-art machine learning library for NLP, computer vision, and audio. 100k+ pretrained models.

skills.name: PEFT

skills.name: TRL

skills.name: LangSmith

skills.name: Arize Phoenix
skills.description: Open-source LLM observability platform. Provides tracing, evaluation, and drift detection for LLM applications.

skills.name: Langfuse
skills.description: Open-source LLM engineering platform. Observability, analytics, evaluations, and prompt management.

skills.name: MLflow
skills.description: Open-source platform for the ML lifecycle. Experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and project reproducibility.

skills.name: DVC

skills.name: Prefect
